disposition.note: The whole outer table. The cell fills, the vertical merge of the nested USA cell, the cell vertical centring and the narrower point-sized column widths are lost with each universal-measure w:tcW (#2245). The table sits 10pt high because the 8pt after and 12.95pt line of w:pPrDefault are dropped (#2394). The outer left and right rules are black because w:start and w:end in w:tblBorders are ignored (#2395); they also lose their middle segments beside the tall second row (#2145), and the empty paragraph closing the outer cell adds a line under the nested table (#2238). Face and size match the reference after this fix.

Ours sits at the top of the cell because the cell's w:vAlign is lost with its universal-measure w:tcW (#2245), and starts from a table placed 10pt high (#2394). The glyph shapes match: same Carlito face at 11pt.
